derivationRule: Each question answer contributes its first character to the final 10-character Mystery Box access code. Combine First(Q01) + First(Q02) + ... + First(Q10) in sequential order.

questions.title: Question 1: Student Record Section
questions.text: Locate student 24CS1479 in the student records. What section is assigned to this student?
questions.derivation: The assigned section letter becomes character #1 of the Mystery Box access code.

questions.title: Question 2: Event Fee Communication Trace
questions.text: A communication at 03-19 20:43:54 IST says “need 450 for the event fee, will return tomorrow”. Identify the sender, then use the student records to determine that student’s section. Return the section.
questions.derivation: The sender student's section letter becomes character #2 of the Mystery Box access code.

questions.title: Question 3: Transaction Timestamp to System Event
questions.text: Transaction TXN00036970 occurred at 09:00:42 IST. Convert that time to UTC, then find the closest system event for the same student. Return the system record number.
questions.derivation: The first character of the system record number becomes character #3 of the Mystery Box access code.

questions.title: Question 4: Grade Update Device Lease
questions.text: System record 26134 is a CS2103 grade-update event from IP 10.20.4.87 at 2026-03-10 20:19:05 UTC. Convert the event time to IST and use the device lease records to identify the device holding that IP at that exact time. Return the device ID.
questions.derivation: The first character of the device ID becomes character #4 of the Mystery Box access code.

questions.title: Question 5: Post-Grade-Update Transaction
questions.text: Find the CS2103 grade-update event where the new grade is 82. Convert its UTC timestamp to IST. For the same student, locate the first transaction strictly after that converted time. Return the transaction ID.
questions.derivation: The first character of the transaction ID becomes character #5 of the Mystery Box access code.

questions.title: Question 6: Latest Communication Transaction
questions.text: A communication at 03-19 20:43:54 IST says “need 450 for the event fee, will return tomorrow”. Identify the sender, then find that student’s latest transaction on 03-20. Return the transaction ID.
questions.derivation: The first character of the transaction ID becomes character #6 of the Mystery Box access code.

questions.title: Question 7: Record Inquiry Transaction Trace
questions.text: At 03-04 08:19:23 IST, a communication asks “did you finish the record?”. Identify the recipient, then find that recipient’s first transaction after the message time. Return the transaction ID.
questions.derivation: The first character of the transaction ID becomes character #7 of the Mystery Box access code.

questions.title: Question 8: System Event Device Active Lease
questions.text: System record 26134 is recorded at 2026-03-10 20:19:05 UTC with IP 10.20.4.87. Convert the time to IST and determine which device lease was active for that IP at the exact moment. Return the device ID.
questions.derivation: The first character of the device ID becomes character #8 of the Mystery Box access code.

questions.title: Question 9: Grade 82 Chronological Transaction
questions.text: Find the CS2103 grade-update event whose new grade is 82. Convert its UTC timestamp to IST. For that same student, find the first transaction strictly after the converted event time. Return the transaction ID.
questions.derivation: The first character of the transaction ID becomes character #9 of the Mystery Box access code.

questions.title: Question 10: Closest Event Time Correlation
questions.text: Transaction TXN00036970 occurred at 09:00:42 IST. Identify the student from the transaction, convert the timestamp to UTC, and trace that student into the system records. Return the record number of the closest event in time.
questions.derivation: The first character of the closest event record number becomes character #10 of the Mystery Box access code.
